title: Byte Engine LUT bake settings
description: Optional bake settings for .lut and .cube assets.

$schema.description: The local JSON Schema reference for this asset.

lut.description: Bakes the table through a pixel shader, so the baked table holds the shader's result with this file as its look.

through.description: The ID of a pixel shader that takes the Lut layer, such as byte_engine/rendering/color-grading/aces2.besl.

size.description: The baked table's entries per side. Defaults to 65. A larger table follows the shader more closely and takes more memory and bake time.
